sunscorch_caravanmaster.default_dialog: Sada adjusts a route marker on her ledger before looking up.
sunscorch_caravanmaster.description: A precise, sun-browned caravanmaster who knows every water marker between the mountains and the far dunes.

dialog.greeting: Sunscorch trades in safe arrivals. Water, wheels, and honest route news cost less than a rescue.
dialog.oasis: The Mirror Oasis is holding water, last I heard. Do not believe a reflection until you have tasted it.
dialog.trade: Desert prices are not cruel; they are what it costs to bring a thing here twice.

sunscorch_caravanmaster.name: Sada the Caravanmaster

sunscorch_waterkeeper.default_dialog: Nahl listens to the cistern spillway with practiced attention.
sunscorch_waterkeeper.description: A calm waterkeeper with dust on their sandals and an exact ear for the sound of a leaking cistern.

dialog.desert: Travel at first light, rest under cover, and do not leave the marked track to chase an easy horizon.
dialog.greeting: Water is not a commodity here. It is the agreement that lets the town exist.

sunscorch_waterkeeper.name: Nahl the Waterkeeper
